title: Prove sharp common-E8 embedding bound for tensor pairing
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR3895 leaves an embedding into the selected 9-bit/P112 alphabet open. This package closes the **literal tensor-pairing** route and proves a sharp boundary for its principal restrictions.

For `B4 = P16 + J16`, the full binary rank is 16, excluding any nine-bit bilinear source/reader maps. Under an **injective common E8 root-line map**, a principal restriction has at most **eight vertices**: its real Gram matrix is a positive-definite matching of singleton and A2 blocks. An explicit eight-root witness attains the bound in the actual selected ports.

The witness preserves pairing only. Restricting the predecessor tensor decoder to it still produces a nonzero coefficient where the selected masked identity requires zero, even after favorable global normalization. The package also distinguishes the rank-only ceiling of 12 from actual embeddings and checks nine distinct abstract binary labels which E8 geometry excludes.

Only `research/tensor-pairing-embedding-bound/` is added. The universal proof is in `PROOF.md`; retained source files are hashed and parsed for literals, never executed.

## Validation

Validation on exact public head `2b2daaecac95e1048923d22fda51ccd01780565f`, CPython 3.12.14:

- All 65,536 principal restrictions and all 12,544 root-to-selected-port pairings pass.
- The sharp eight-root witness, nine-label abstract example, noninjective scope calibration, scalar mismatch and seven rejection controls pass in normal and optimized modes.
- Registered package replay and source-history/commit-byte checks pass; worktree remains clean.
- Relocated optimized replay passes with only declared inputs. Corrupting the claimed bound, retained source or selected archive is rejected.
- Separate AI proof and integration reviews found no actionable issue. No independent human or proof-assistant verification is claimed.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/tensor-pairing-embedding-bound
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/tensor-pairing-embedding-bound --check-source-history
```

Hosted confirmation: [run 39196402652](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39196402652) **passed** on the merge test of this exact head into base `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90` (merge-test SHA `8c5499acd269303a92169f7e517d14094bc5380e`). CPython 3.12.15 ran both registered modes successfully; the committed-inputs check also passed. This corroborates replay, not scientific acceptance. A further source-premise review checked all 256 entries of the predecessor tensor factorization over Q(i) and confirmed the normalized 2-versus-0 scalar counterexample.

## Task and overlap

Canonical main was refreshed at entry, at the implementation checkpoint, and again at 03:52 UTC for handoff: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6, unchanged. Final prepublication overlap covers 631 open PR bodies including drafts with complete pagination; Discussion coverage is manual and incomplete. [Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3925). The task card records refinement from `complex-rank-shape-decoder` and all source pins.

## Remaining obligations

**Limits:** the eight-vertex cap requires distinct root lines and one common map. Separate maps for smaller restrictions, recoding, splitting and changed identities remain outside it. No general effective-rank/COPY floor, physical tariff, dirty-input consumer, supplier admission or new kappa is claimed. Selected construction/compiler, hosting, restoration, precision/tape, analytic and bit H1-H5 obligations remain open; the frontier is unchanged. Hosted CI is separate from these local checks.

## Credit

 homelab-05 / 1337isnot1337 (#3895) for the tensor decoder and embedding question; Gonzalo Mier (#3566) for the explicit selected-port map; Adam Gall's retained P112 geometry; DreamingOfClouds (#717), themilkman216 (#968), woklerx (#1077), and the retained E8 lineage. Hanson Sun / bbMisk (#1633), #3567 and #3039 provide distinct nearby scope. Prepared by ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including bounded AI subagents. Apache-2.0; predecessor bytes and attribution preserved.

## Open next questions

Specify a changed pairing/consumer contract, such as separate maps or recoding, and verify every constrained scalar coefficient before pricing it. The literal full sixteen-port pairing cannot fit nine-bit labels. Only after a new exact identity survives should the full dirty-input, restoration and hosting bill be developed. [Detailed scope and next questions](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2b2daaecac95e1048923d22fda51ccd01780565f/research/tensor-pairing-embedding-bound/README.md#open-next-questions).
